channel.title: Bank Statement Parser
channel.description: Open-source Python library to parse CAMT.053, PAIN.001, CSV, OFX, QFX, MT940, and PDF bank statements. 27K+ tx/s, hybrid PDF pipeline, REST API, 100% local.

item.title: v0.0.8 — Full Platform
item.description: Multi-currency balance verification, hledger/beancount export, bulk directory scanner, account mapping rules, REST API microservice.

item.title: v0.0.7 — Universal Vision
item.description: Direct Ollama bridge, strip mode for dense pages, minicpm-v recommendation.

item.title: v0.0.6 — Intelligence Layer
item.description: Enrichment module, interactive review mode, per-row bounding boxes. Python 3.9 dropped.

item.title: v0.0.5 — Universal Extraction
item.description: Hybrid PDF pipeline with deterministic/text-LLM/vision-LLM routing. Golden Rule balance verification.
